utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Good morning, everyone. Will the Registrar call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. This is the case number IT-05-88-A, the Prosecutor versus Popovic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, Registry. [Microphone not activated] May I have the appearances beginning with the Prosecution, please, if I may.

utterances.speaker: MR. WOOD
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Kyle Wood and Todd Schneider for the Prosecution, along with Case Manager Janet Stewart.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, learned counsel. May I also have the appearance for the Defence for Mr. Popovic, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. My name is Mira Tapuskovic, co-counsel for Vujadin Popovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, learned counsel. And for Mr. Beara.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. John Ostojic on behalf of Mr. Beara. Good morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, learned counsel. And for Mr. Nikolic, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOURGON
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President. I am representing Drago Nikolic, Stephane Bourgon from Montreal, Canada. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, learned counsel. And for Mr. Miletic.

utterances.speaker: MS. FAUVEAU
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Natacha Fauveau Ivanovic with Nenad Petrusic for Radivoje Miletic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, learned counsel. And finally Mr. Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Peter Haynes for Vinko Pandurevic, with my case manager Helena Tosic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, learned counsel. [Microphone not activated] Yes. Before we continue I would like to confirm that all the appellants are able to follow the proceedings in a language they understand.

utterances.speaker: MS. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: Your Honour, sorry for interrupting you, Mr. Popovic already sent his waiver and he is going to be represented while he's absent by me. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Okay. Yes. He has waived his right to be present in this proceeding; is that correct, learned counsel?

utterances.speaker: MS. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: And the matter is on record --

utterances.speaker: MS. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: -- Registry?

utterances.speaker: MS. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: Your Honour, just before the commencement of this Status Conference, I contacted the Registry and they told me that his waiver is already filed.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MS. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Okay. We take due note of that. So Mr. Popovic is not here for the reason that has been outlined in his waiver notice that has been filed already with the Registry. Mr. Beara.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT BEARA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [No interpretation]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Can you repeat what you said? I'm sorry, I missed that, Mr. Beara.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT BEARA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [No interpretation]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: There is no interpretation.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Can you hear the interpretation now?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Yes, I hear you but I haven't heard the interpretation.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note: We cannot hear the judge now.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT BEARA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [In English] I said I hear clear and loud.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Mr. Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. President, I can hear the proceedings in a language I understand. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you. And Mr. Miletic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT MILETIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. President, I can hear you well and I understand what is being said.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you. And finally, Mr. Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I can hear and understand. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you. Let me now begin by providing a brief summary of the recent public decisions issued by the Appeals Chamber. One: On 14th March, 2014, the Appeals Chamber issued a public decision, denying, by majority, Judge Nyambe dissenting, the application by Vinko Pandurevic for provisional release. And two: On 28th March, 2014, Judge Robinson, Presiding Judge, issued a confidential order relating to a request by the Prosecution for augmentation of the protective measures of one witness, instructing the Victim and Witnesses Section of the Tribunal to consult with the witness. I will now provide a very brief summary of the status of the pending motions and decisions before the Appeals Chamber in this case. The Appeals Chamber is currently seized of, first: Five motions filed by Mr. Popovic pursuant to Rule 115 of the Rules, filed on 15 August, 2011; 2 September, 2013; 1 October, 2013; 11 November, 2013; and 14th January, 2014. Three motions filed by Mr. Nikolic - that is, two - three motions filed by Mr. Nikolic pursuant to Rule 115 of the Rules filed on 4 October, 18 October, 25 November, 2013, all responses and replies have been received by the Appeals Chamber and the motions remain under consideration by the Chamber. Three, the Appeals Chamber is also seized of a request by the Prosecution for augmentation of protective measures of one witness filed on 30 January, 2014. And that covers the summary of pending motions. If there are any matters to be raised by counsel, we can do that after I have heard from the appellants on the status of their health. May I now ask the appellants whether they wish to raise any concerns regarding their health or the conditions of their detention. I take note Mr. Popovic is not around and has waived his right to be here, so I'll start with Mr. Beara. Mr. Beara, do you have any issues to raise?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT BEARA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I have no problems.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. President, I'm in good health and I have no problems.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you. And Mr. Miletic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT MILETIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. President, my health is in accordance with the reports that you have been receiving from the medical unit of the Detention Unit. If you allow me, I would like to take this opportunity to thank the staff of the Detention Unit for all their care during my illness. I would particularly like to thank Dr. Falke and the medical staff for their care and concern about my health. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you very much and we have taken good note of the observation that you have made in that connection. And finally, Mr. Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have no problems. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. May I now ask whether there are any additional matters to be raised by the Prosecution or any of the counsel? Prosecution, learned counsel?

utterances.speaker: MR. WOOD
utterances.text: Nothing from the Prosecution, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you. Any member of the Defence? Any issue?

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: Yes. I trust you'll forgive the impertinence, but perhaps on behalf of Mr. Pandurevic and vicariously on behalf of the other parties to the case, I wondered whether the Chamber was in a position to give us some sort of guidance as to when this appeal might be finalised?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you. You are learned counsel for?

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: I'm counsel for Mr. Pandurevic, Mr. Haynes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Mr. Haynes. Okay. This is what I wish to observe for the moment. As you know, the appeal hearing, this case took place -- the appeal hearing, this case took place on the 2nd to 6th December, 2013. The Chamber has been involved in a deliberative process since the hearing. This is a very voluminous case, and I'm afraid that I cannot give you a satisfactory projection at this time. However, when the judgement is ready for delivery, we will endeavour to issue a Scheduling Order with as much notice as we can. That's all that can be observed for now. Any other comments from learned counsel for the Defence, if I may?

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: Only gratitude. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, learned counsel. Any other observation? Nothing. There being no other matters to be raised, the hearing is hereby adjourned. Thank you very much.
